title: The Free Companies' smuggler route (Grain Run for Sparrow -> Sack Road Camp -> Gullhaven's smugglers' stair/cave/cleft) silently skips Hollowbrook, Cinderhall, Fenmarch and Thornwold -- the exact holds each of the four companions' personal grief-quests point to -- with no confirmation prompt. The only signal is companion banter at the Smugglers' Cleft ('Hollowbrook's behind us... Cinderhall's behind us...'); the explicit system warning ('A companion's grief left unfinished there stays unfinished unless you walk back for it.') only appears afterward, at the Pass Gate, once the skip has already happened.
where: Saltkerns / The Smugglers' Cleft and The Pass Gate
